split-card-carousel.looks: A section title, then wide white slides shown one at a time: a photo on the left; a heading, text and up to two buttons on the right; dots and arrows underneath. Other styles show fixed-size cards with a 300px photo and a soft shadow.
split-card-carousel.use: Events, stories or programmes shown in turn, e.g. regional events.
split-card-carousel.avoid: A single item: use Split Card.

fields.heading: Optional section title above the slides.
fields.variant: default: full-width slides with arrows and dots. variant-2: fixed-size cards with a narrow photo and a soft shadow, text always left-aligned. variant-3: another compact card layout. Keep default unless asked.

fields.image: A photo; it fills the slide's left side.
fields.heading: A few words.
fields.contentAlign: left, center or right for this slide's text.
